# A useful question can be an interruption

The interview guide recommends asking for an example whenever someone generalizes. During today's conversation the speaker was still finding the words. My request for specificity broke the thread. [[Listening]]: a good technique applied at the wrong moment can stop the thing it was meant to support. Try leaving the example request until the person finishes.
